name: Digicom Electronics
old_description: is a certified Small Business that has been proudly manufacturing electronics in the California Bay Area since 1982.
about:
Digicom Electronics, a certified small business, has been manufacturing electronics in Oakland, California since 1982. The company operates as a subsidiary of India-based Kaynes Technology Group, combining U.S.-based production with global supply-chain resources.

The shop provides end-to-end electronic manufacturing services, including printed circuit board assembly (surface-mount, through-hole, and mixed technology), cable and wire harness fabrication, box build, and full test sequences such as functional, burn-in, optical, and X-ray inspection. An advanced high-speed SMT line supports larger volumes, while a newly expanded stock room and kitting operation feed quick-turn prototypes and low- to mid-volume production runs. Turnkey and consignment programs are managed with dedicated program oversight.

Customers span aerospace, defense, medical devices, industrial automation, IT and telecommunications, and railway sectors. A noted project includes the ROACH system built for CASPER and radio astronomy institutes, which contributed to the first image of a black hole. The firm emphasizes secure, compliant builds for defense-grade electronics and precision manufacturing for life-saving medical innovations.

Digicom differentiates itself through its ITAR-registered, U.S.-based facility, AS9100/ISO 9001/ISO 13485/NADCAP certifications, and the backing of Kaynes Group’s international scale. The company quotes standard builds in two business days and complex new-product introductions in five, and it specializes in small runs, NPI support, and design-to-troubleshoot assistance for challenging electronic products.
